Full control (full_control true, new_threads_only false): ongoing ('Ynt:') threads are answered too and a thread Hamle answered is carried on (at most 5 replies by itself, never after an unconfirmed send), a mail written to a teammate with hamle@ only in CC waits 20 minutes for that person (team_grace_minutes, default chosen by Claude); every attachment is read with the mail and an unread or undescribed attachment keeps the reply from going out by itself. rules: enabled=true only with Ahmet's word in the thread. Client addresses come from the Firestore 'client-contacts' doc (v11_client_watch.py contacts import on the Mac), never from this file or git. mode 'silent_draft': nothing is ever sent. mode 'reply': only brands in reply.brands and mails received after reply.since get a same-thread reply (v11_client_reply); every other mail stays a silent draft. Adding a brand or a client address is Ahmet's GO. shadow_from: agency people whose 'Gölge:' forwards are drafted silently (never sent; the chain skips them). A contact row is auto-send only with direct=true (Markalar 'doğrudan yazabilir mi' = Evet). jobs: client mails of the listed brands that the draft marks job_ready open to-dos in the brand's Basecamp lists (v11_client_job); uploads are scored once each; 90+ goes to the client as an attachment in the same thread, 80-89 waits for an approver's 'uygun', below 80 is a revision request (max_revisions), then the approvers decide. mentions: only verified agency people's comments that name Hamle, on client-hidden to-dos of routed brand projects or the New Business project (never the internal 'Hamle İşleri' project, which the chain answers); one model call per mention; client mail drafts only for reply.brands and the client table's addresses of that brand; sent only after an approver's 'Hamle gönder'. reply.full_control true with new_threads_only false = full control (ongoing threads answered too and carried on, at most 5 times per thread by itself); reply.team_grace_minutes: a mail addressed to a teammate waits that long; reply.team_threads: Gmail threads the team runs alone (Hamle neither answers nor notes them). Attachments are always read (v11_attachments).
